title: The Cultivation of the Tao, and the Observation of its Effects
chinese: 善建者不拔，善抱者不脱，子孙以祭祀不辍。
故以身观身，以家观家，以乡观乡，以国观国，以天下观天下。
pinyin: Shàn jiàn zhě bù bá， shàn bào zhě bù tuō， zi sūn yǐ jì sì bù chuò。
Xiū zhī yú shēn， qí dé nǎi zhēn；
Xiū zhī yú jiā， qí dé nǎi yú；
Xiū zhī yú xiāng， qí dé nǎi zhǎng；
Xiū zhī yú guó， qí dé nǎi fēng；
Xiū zhī yú tiān xià， qí dé nǎi pǔ。
Gù yǐ shēn guān shēn， yǐ jiā guān jiā， yǐ xiāng guān xiāng， yǐ guó guān guó， yǐ tiān xià guān tiān xià。
Wú hé yǐ zhī tiān xià rán zāi？
english: What (Tao’s) skilful planter plants Tao’s Can never be uptorn; What his skilful arms enfold, From him can ne’er be borne. Sons shall bring in lengthening line, Sacrifices to his shrine.

Tao when nursed within one’s self, Tao His vigour will make true; And where the family it rules What riches will accrue! The neighbourhood where it prevails In thriving will abound; And when ’tis seen throughout the state, Good fortune will be found. Employ it the kingdom o’er, And men thrive all around.
In this way the effect will be seen in the person, by the observation of different cases; in the family; in the neighbourhood; in the state; and in the kingdom.
How do I know that this effect is sure to hold thus all under the sky? By this (method of observation).
